name: Largest top-level folders (Windows)
description: Totals disk usage of each top-level folder under a root directory (one level deep) and lists the largest, within a time budget.

params.name: root_dir
params.label: Root directory
params.description: Absolute Windows path whose immediate sub-folders are measured.

params.name: top_n
params.label: Number of folders
params.description: How many folders to list (1 to 50).

output: Table of the largest sub-folders with sizes and a note if the time budget cut the scan short. Exit 0; exit 2 on an invalid parameter.
